verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples for Stripe's crypto and stablecoin products. The machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages), the sandbox provisioning command, the CLI and the MCP server are adjacent features, not an interactive runnable reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
